en.headline: ICAC charges Kai Tak Hospital site team leader over bribes from workers
en.dek: A 52-year-old subcontractor team leader faces 10 counts of accepting advantages totalling HK$75,100 from five imported electrical workers.
body: The Independent Commission Against Corruption charged a site team leader of an electrical subcontractor on the Kai Tak Hospital construction project with accepting bribes from imported workers.

Zeng Chusong, 52, of Billion Best (E&M) Engineering Company Limited, faces 10 counts of agent accepting an advantage under the Prevention of Bribery Ordinance. The case was mentioned at Tuen Mun Magistrates’ Courts on Thursday.

The ICAC alleges that between September and November 2026 he accepted 10 bribes totalling HK$75,100 from five electrical workers in return for helping them secure and keep employment on the project. The workers, each on a daily wage of HK$1,300, paid amounts ranging from HK$9,000 to HK$23,600 out of fear of losing their jobs.

China State Construction Engineering (Hong Kong) Limited is the main contractor. The ICAC said it maintains a zero-tolerance policy towards corruption and will continue working with the Development Bureau and other stakeholders to prevent similar cases. It urged construction workers solicited for bribes to refuse and report the matter.

zh.headline: 廉署起訴啟德醫院建築項目分判商工頭涉收賄
zh.dek: 52歲分判商工頭面對10項代理人接受利益控罪，涉向五名輸入電工收取共75,100元。
body: 廉政公署起訴啟德醫院建築項目一名分判商工頭，控告他涉嫌向輸入勞工收受利益。
被告曾楚松，52歲，任職億達利電機工程有限公司工頭，面對10項《防止賄賂條例》下的代理人接受利益控罪。案件周四在屯門裁判法院提訊。
廉署指，被告於2026年9月至11月期間從五名電工收取10筆賄款共75,100元，以協助他們獲聘及繼續受僱於項目。該五名電工日薪1,300元，因擔心失去工作而分別支付9,000元至23,600元。
中國建築工程（香港）有限公司為項目總承建商。廉署表示對貪污採取零容忍政策，並會繼續與發展局及其他持份者合作防止同類案件。當局呼籲建造業工人若被索賄應立即拒絕並向廉署舉報。
